svg.aria-label: A safe-deposit bench. A heavy vault block, the Secure Enclave, is bolted to a plinth; its key never leaves it. On the left a card file holds sealed envelope cards, one per secret, each with a name tab; one card stands in the block's slot being opened. A fingerprint reader is wired to the block, a one-hour time-lock dial on its lid shows 42 minutes of session left, a tape printer logs each read, and the opened envelope lies in a tray for the process.
svg.text: ONE TOUCH · THEN READS UNTIL LOCK
